name: TaskMaster
description: Runs Jellyfin scheduled tasks sequentially inside a configurable time window, ordered by fastest or slowest completion time. Includes backup and restore of native triggers, a take-over/release workflow, and detection of newly added tasks.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Sequential task execution with fastest-first or slowest-first ordering. Configurable time window with overnight support. Per-task day-of-week exclusions. Backup, restore, and download of native task triggers. Take over / Release workflow that preserves startup triggers. Detection of newly added and orphaned tasks. Drag-and-drop task reordering.
